analysis: TaskCanceledException is a subclass of OperationCanceledException, so which exact type surfaces depends on the non-deterministic timing/path of the cancellation (e.g. whether a Task.Delay or a manual CancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested triggers it). The test asserts an exact type match via Assert.IsType, making it sensitive to this race. The PR under analysis (#20279) only modifies DCP executor/orchestrator files and does not touch Maui build queue code, so this failure is unrelated to the PR changes.
